'''Garth Angus Wheatley''' (28 May 1923	– 4 September 2001) was an English [[first-class cricket]]er active 1946–50 who played for [[Surrey County Cricket Club|Surrey]] and [[Oxford University Cricket Club|Oxford University]]. He was born in [[Twickenham]]; died in [[Uppingham]].<ref name=CA>[https://cricketarchive.com/Archive/Players/33/33765/33765.html Garth Wheatley at CricketArchive]</ref>

Wheatley was educated at [[Uppingham School]] and [[Balliol College, Oxford]]. After achieving a [[first-class honours degree]] and a [[doctorate]] he returned to Uppingham in 1951 to teach physics, but was also master-in-charge of cricket for 32 years.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.etonfives.com/obituaries/1783-garth-wheatley |title=Garth Wheatley |publisher=Eton Fives Association}}</ref>
